headline: PT PII Gets Role Guaranteeing Woosh Debt, Valued at Rp2 Trillion
summary: PT Penjaminan Infrastruktur Indonesia is guaranteeing Rp2 trillion of debt for the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway. The guarantee uses a co-guarantee scheme with the Finance Ministry.
why: PT PII is a state-backed infrastructure guarantee company in Indonesia. Government guarantees affect the credit risk and financing costs of major infrastructure projects.
original_headline: PT PII Kebagian Jamin Utang Woosh, Nilainya Rp2 Triliun
